nodes.name: cobol_orm_error
nodes.doc:
@brief Unified error status codes returned by every cobol-orm function.
Values 0..31 match `c_orm_error_t` 1:1 for lossless error percolation across
the C89 and COBOL FFI boundary. Values 32..36 represent COBOL FFI facade and
legacy integer-handle / COMMAREA dispatch errors.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_NOT_FOUND
variants.doc: @brief Requested row, column, or handle not found.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
variants.doc: @brief Feature or driver capability not implemented.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_VALIDATION
variants.doc: @brief Invalid argument or domain/level-88 validation failure.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_READ_ONLY
variants.doc: @brief Write attempted on read-only database or resource.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_CONSTRAINT
variants.doc: @brief Unique, foreign-key, or CHECK constraint violation.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_DRIVER_LOAD
variants.doc: @brief Dynamic database client library failed to load.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_ODBC_DIAG
variants.doc: @brief Underlying ODBC or IBM Db2 CLI diagnostic error.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_TIMEOUT
variants.doc: @brief Login, pool acquisition, or query timeout.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_TRUNCATION
variants.doc: @brief Disallowed string, binary, or fractional truncation.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_DECIMAL_SYNTAX
variants.doc: @brief Malformed decimal string or invalid BCD/COMP-3 sign nybble.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_DECIMAL_OVERFLOW
variants.doc: @brief Decimal precision exceeded or division by zero.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_DECIMAL_INEXACT
variants.doc: @brief Non-zero digits lost under exact rounding mode.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_CODEPAGE
variants.doc: @brief Unmappable character or malformed UTF/EBCDIC sequence.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_COPYBOOK_SYNTAX
variants.doc: @brief COBOL Copybook (.cpy) lexer or parser syntax error.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
variants.doc: @brief Opaque handle is invalid, corrupted, or already closed.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL
variants.doc: @brief Caller-provided output buffer capacity is insufficient.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_NOT_CONNECTED
variants.doc: @brief Operation requires an active database connection.

variants.name: COBOL_ORM_ERROR_HANDLE_TABLE_FULL
variants.doc: @brief Legacy integer handle registry has no free slots available.
